items.t: Charging unit (ICCU) failure and loss of drive power (recall)
items.job: Inspect ICCU and fuse, replace if needed, update software (recall)
items.note: If the ICCU fails again after the recall, it is normally covered by the EV component warranty; keep every repair order.

items.t: 12-volt battery goes flat and the car won't wake up
items.job: Test charging system; replace 12-volt AGM battery if worn
items.note: If the ICCU or software is the cause, the dealer fix is usually covered under warranty.

items.t: Car slows into limp mode while driving
items.job: Vehicle control unit software update (bulletin 24-01-091G)

items.t: Rear driveshafts can break (recall)
items.job: Replace both rear driveshafts under recall

items.t: Rear inner driveshaft may be weak and snap (recall)
items.job: Replace rear inner driveshaft under recall

items.t: Seat belt pretensioner can burst in a crash (recall)
items.job: Install cap over seat belt pretensioners under recall

items.t: Front passenger seat belt may not extend or latch (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace front passenger seat belt under recall

items.t: Instrument display can go blank (recall)
items.job: Display software update under recall

items.t: Windshield top trim can come off (recall)
items.job: Replace windshield top molding under recall

items.t: Backup camera can shut off in reverse (recall)
items.job: Rearview camera software update under recall

items.t: Check engine light and charging stops at 80%
items.job: Battery management software update (bulletin 24-01-070G)

items.t: Limited-slip differential warning
items.job: Diagnose and repair electronic limited-slip differential actuator
items.note: Usually covered under the powertrain warranty.

items.t: Horn stops working
items.job: Test and replace horns

items.t: Rattle from the tailgate
items.job: Add washers to tailgate side guide bumpers

items.t: Fast-charge port missing pin covers
items.job: Install DC charge pin caps

items.t: Brake lights and one-pedal driving act oddly
items.job: Vehicle control unit software update (bulletin 23-01-082G)

items.t: Steering wheel buttons stop working
items.job: Steering wheel switch software update

items.t: Genesis Connected Services drop out
items.job: Diagnose telematics and update software

items.t: Car brakes hard on its own
items.job: Inspect and recalibrate front radar and camera
items.note: Cost is mainly diagnosis and calibration time; covered under warranty on newer cars.

items.t: Cargo mat coming apart
items.job: Replace cargo mat

items.t: Liftgate latch cover stuck down
items.job: Inspect and replace rear transverse trim
